          children: "0777"
        }), ")\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {

      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "而不是："
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {

      children: _jsx(_components.p, {
        children: "只有一个候选，也不能证明它就是当前 AllocateRequest 对应的 Pod，仍需排除过期 annotation 等情况。多个候选都等待 Allocate 时，如果候选集合一直不变，单纯失败并重试可能让它们持续无法启动；还需要配套的身份关联或请求协调机制。"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

      children: "因为："

        children: "GetPreferredAllocation\n"

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["当前 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "volcano-vgpu-device-plugin"

      }), " 实际没有完成这套逻辑。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

        children: "Device ID 对齐\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {
      id: "更直接的方案让-node-lock-带上-owner",
      children: "更直接的方案：让 Node Lock 带上 owner"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["scheduler 在执行 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "GPUDevices.Allocate"
      }), " 时是明确知道 Pod 身份的："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {

        children: "namespace\nname\nUID\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "因此一个更直接的改造方向，是把当前 node lock 从："
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "timestamp\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "扩展成："
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "timestamp\nnamespace\npodName\npodUID\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "例如："
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "hamivgpu:\n<timestamp>_<namespace>_<podName>_<podUID>\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "scheduler 获取锁时写入 owner。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "Device Plugin 收到 AllocateRequest 后，不再扫描所有 Pod 并按时间猜测，而是："
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "读取当前 Node 的 lock owner\n        ↓\n得到准确 Pod UID\n        ↓\n直接读取对应 Pod\n        ↓\n校验：\nvgpu-node\ndevices-to-allocate\nbind-phase\n        ↓\n执行 Allocate\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "成功或者失败后，再由相同 owner 释放 lock。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "这样能把 scheduler 记录的 Pod 身份传给 Device Plugin，但还不能单凭 lock owner 证明当前 AllocateRequest 就属于这个 Pod。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(ObsidianCallout, {

function MDXContent(props = {}) {
  const {wrapper: MDXLayout} = {
    ..._provideComponents(),
    ...props.components
  };
  return MDXLayout ? _jsx(MDXLayout, {
    ...props,
    children: _jsx(_createMdxContent, {
      ...props
    })
  }) : _createMdxContent(props);
}
return {
  default: MDXContent
};
function _missingMdxReference(id, component) {
  throw new Error("Expected " + (component ? "component" : "object") + " `" + id + "` to be defined: you likely forgot to import, pass, or provide it.");
}
